boundary: stock presentation atlas records, bitmap-font ABI, reusable composition primitives, semantic hit geometry, and renderer teardown

primitives.contract: one exact atlas record with logical size and trim origin
finite glyph set, wrapper metrics, kerning, alignment, wrapping, tint
record-backed repeated or clipped fill without resampling the source ABI
mirrored corners plus exact edge slices and deterministic painter order
UI.101 idle, UI.102 pressed, UI.54 ends, Fonts group 3 label; disabled art/text alpha 0.5 plus gray rect alpha 0.25
UI.13 bracket pairs; selected label rises 8 px and bracket span grows 51 to 65 px
UI.107-110 outer corners, UI.10/79 edges, UI.49 fill, UI.17 inner frame, UI.18 header, UI.8 arrows
stock frame, authored rows, semantic hit bounds, opening/closing presentation supplied by the owner
